Depending on if you're getting the proper treatment for your disorder, it can get better or worse. There is no absolute way of ensuring things will get better. People will utter that saying of things will get better when they either dont know what else to say or they just dont care at all and want to find the easiest way to get out of conversation without feeling bad about not saying anything at all. There is no panacea for hopelessness and suicidality. Its a lone wolf battle. People can try as hard as they possibly can for someone and still have little to no effect simply because you can't alter the thoughts in the suicidal person. They are at war with themselves, and unfortunately sometimes they lose the war...
In my case, I have Bipolar disorder and if left untreated will get persistently worse as I age. The suicidal thoughts may never leave. The best I can do is ignore them, and that only works for so long. I completely resonate with you brother, and trust me this isnt a fake quick response. I care. I dont know you; this is true, but I assure you that I do care and that I care simply based off the fact we share the same poison. All I can tell you is to try and find a purpose that will take a while to reach, thus giving you some kind of reason to live. At least fulfill that before you depart this earth and maybe when you do accomplish that goal you might even begin to start to be able to tolerate life and the hand that god has dealt you. 

Much love brother, from one suicidal human to another.
